_comment: Home spotlight: a compact card at the bottom of the home page that invites the visitor to open one publication. It appears once per browser session (sessionStorage), after `delayMilliseconds`, only on the home page of a language that has texts here, and never on the publication itself. Set enabled to false to remove it from the build.
